s: AstftO । sOtraDAturayam । iti kavikalpadrumaH ॥ (BvAM-paraM-sakaM-sew .) kutapaH । iti durgAdAsaH ॥ kut apastyaH kutapaH kAlaviSezaH । kfttiracitasnehapAtraYca । iti kecit ॥
m: कुत् a Sautra root (i.e. one found in grammatical Sūtras only), to spread.
कु—तापसी f. a wicked female ascetic, ib.
कु—तापस m. a wicked ascetic, Kathās.
कु-तापस &c. See 1. कु.
कु—तार्किक m. a bad logician.
कुतीपाद m. N. of one of the Ṛṣis of the Sāma-veda, ĀrṣBr.
कु—तीर्थ m. a bad teacher.
कुत्थ (in astron.) the fifteenth Yoga, VarBṛ.

s: strI, (kutsitaM tanyate । tan bAhulakAt kUH । wilopaSca .) carmmanirmmitasnehapAtram । ityamaraH । 2 । 9 । 33 ॥ masaka iti kupo iti ca BAzA ॥
v: strI kuta--bA॰ kU । carmmamaya snehapAtre (kupo) amaraH
m: कुतू f. a leathern oil-bottle, Pāṇ. v, 3, 89.

k.v: कुतूः कृत्तेः स्नेहपात्रं सैवाल्पा कुतुपः पुमान्. सर्वमावपनं भाण्डं पात्रामत्रं च भाजनम्.।

s: puM, (ku Izat tURayati saNkocayati cakzuH yaH । ku + tURa saNkoce + Rvul .) bAlarogaviSezaH । sa tu netrarogaH । katuyA iti BAzA । tasya lakzaRam ॥ “kutURakaH kzIradozAcCiSUnAmeva vartmani । jAyate tena tannetraM kaRqUraYca sravenmuhuH ॥ SiSuH kuryyAllalAwAkzikUwanAsAvaGarzaRam । Sakto nArkapraBAM drazwuM na vartmonmIlanakzamaH” ॥ iti mADavakaraH ॥ kukURaka ityapi pAwaH ॥ (yaTA, -- “kukURakaH SiSoreva dantotpattinimittajaH ॥ syAttena SiSurucCUnatAmrAkzo vIkzaRAkzamaH । sa vartmaSUlapEcCilyakarRanAsAkzimarddanaH” ॥ ityuttaratantre 8 aDyAye vABawenoktam ॥ * ॥ cikitsA yaTA ॥ “SuRWI BfNganiSAkalkaH puwapAkaH sasEnDavaH । kukURake'kzirogezu BadramAScyotanaM hitam ॥ krimiGnAlaSilAdArvvI lAkzAkAYjikagErikEH । cUrRAYjanaM kukURe syAcCiSUnAM poTakIzu ca । sudarSanAmUlacUrRAdaYjanaM syAt kukURake” ॥ iti vEdyakacakrapARisaMgrahe bAlarogADikAre ॥)
v: pu॰ “kutU(kU)RakaH kzIradozAcCiSUnAmeva vartmani । jAyate tena tannetraM kaRqUraM ca sravenmahuH । SiSuH kuryyAllalAkzikUwanAsAvaGarzaRam । Sakto nArkapraBAM drazwuM na vartmonmIlanakzamaH” iti mADavanidAnokte bAlAnAM netravartmarogaBede (kutuyA)
m: कुतूणक = कुकूण्˚, L.

s: klI, (kutUM carmmamayatElAdipAtrabat antarhalati sotsukaM karoti । hal + ac .) apUrvvabastudidfkzAdyatiSayaH । tatparyyAyaH । kOtUhalam 2 kOtukaH 3 kutukam 4 । ityamaraH । 1 । 7 । 31 ॥ citram 5 । iti SabdaratnAvalI । (yaTA, nEzaDe । 1 । 119 । “priyAviyogAdviDuro'pi niBara kutUhalAkrAntamanA manAgaBUt” ॥ nAyakAlaNkAraviSezaH । tallakzaRaM yaTA sAhityadarpaRe । 3 । 119 । “ramyavastusamAloke lolatA syAtkutUhalam” ॥)
v: na॰ kutUM carmmamayaM snehapAtramiva hfdayaM halati hala--ac । apUrvvavastudidfkzAtiSayajanye cezwABede PalanirapekzatayA cikIrzite 1 kOtuke amaraH “priyAviyogAdviDuro'pi nirBaraM kutUhalAkrAntamanA manAgaBUt” nEza॰ । “kutUhalAccAruSilopaveSam” BawwiH । “aTasti me SakuntalAdarSanaM prati kutUhalam” Saku॰ 2 praSaste 3 adBute ca tri॰ hemaca॰ । “ramyavastusamAloke lolatA syAt kutUhalam” sA॰ wa॰ ukte 4 nAyakayorBAvaBede na॰ । tArakA॰ itac । kutUhalita jAtakOtuke tri॰ । svArTe yuvA॰ aR । kOtUhala kOtuke na॰ amaraH ।
m: कुतूहल n. (fr. कुतस् and हल, ‘calling out’ ?), curiosity, interest in any extraordinary matter, Sāh. &c.
inclination, desire for (प्रति loc. or in comp.), Śak. &c.
eagerness, impetuosity
what excites curiosity, anything interesting, fun, Pañcat.
कुतूहल mfn. surprising, wonderful, W.
excellent, celebrated, W. (cf. कौतूहल.)
a: कुतूहल — a. 1 Wonderful. --2 Excellent, best. --3 Praised, celebrated. --लं 1 Desire, curiosity; उज्झितशब्देन जनितं नः कुतूहलं Ś. 1; यदि विलासकलासु कुतूहलं Gīt. 1; (पपौ) कुतूहलेनेव मनुष्यशोणितम् R. 3. 54; 13. 21; 15. 65. --2 Eagerness. --3 What excites curiosity, anything pleasing or interesting, a curiosity. --4 Delight, pleasure; U. 1. 20.

k.v: कौतूहलं कौतुकं च कुतुकं च कुतूहलम्. स्त्रीणां विलासबिब्बोकविभ्रमा ललितं तथा॥

m: कुतूहल-शाला f. a room for recreation, Divyāv.
कुतूहल—कृत् mfn. exciting curiosity, Hcar.
कुतूहल—वत् mfn. curious, taking interest in anything, Mālav.
कुतूहलिन् mfn. curious, highly interested in anything, Mn. iv, 63 &c.
eager, impatient.
a: कुतूहलिन् — a. 1 Desirous, struck with curiosity; Māl. 1. --2 Eager, impatient.

m: कुतूहलित mfn. g. तारकादि.

s: [s] vya, praSnaH । paYcamyarTaH । nihnavaH । iti viSvaH । (yaTA, vizRupurARe । 1 । 19 । 37 । “sarvvaBUtAtmake tAta ! jagannATe jaganmaye । paramAtmani govinde mitrAmitrakaTA kutaH” ॥)
v: AstaraRe sO॰ pa॰ saka॰ sew । kotati akotIt । cukota ।
m: कुत m. N. of one of the eighteen attendants of the sun (identified with the god of the ocean), L.
कु—तनय m. a degenerate son, Pañcat.
कु-तनय See 1. कु.

v: strI kugatisa॰ । kutsitAyAM vIRAyAm । seva । 3kzudradaRqe strI । “sa dadarSa SvamAMsasya kutantrIM vitatAM muniH” (viSvAmitraH) BA॰ SA॰ 14 a॰ “kutantrIM daRqikAm” nIlakaRWaH ।
m: कु—तन्त्री f. tail, MBh. xii, 5355 and 5363.

s: puM, (kutsitA tanuryasya । piNgalanetratvAt taTAtvam .) kuveraH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (tri, kutsitaSarIraH । iti vyutpattilabDo'rTaH ॥)
v: puM kutsitA tanurasya । 1 kuvere trikA॰ kuveraSabde vivftiH 2 kutsitadehAnvite tri॰ । kugatisa॰ । 3 kutsitadehe strI ।
m: कु—तनु m. ‘deformed’, N. of Kubera (this deity being of a monstrous appearance, having three legs and but eight teeth), L.
कु-तनु &c. See ib.

s: puM klI, ahno'zwamo'MSaH । divasasyAzwamo mUhUrttaH । yaTA, -- “ahno muhUrttA viKyAtA daSa paYca ca sarvvadA । tatrAzwamo muhUrtto yaH sa kAlaH kutapaH smftaH” ॥ iti SrAdDvatattve matsyapurARavacanam ॥ * ॥ pAriBAzikakutapA yaTA, -- “maDyAhnaH KaNgapAtraYca taTA nepAlakambalaH । rOpyaM darBAstilA gAvo dOhitraScAzwamaH smftaH ॥ pApaM kutsitamityAhustasya santApakAriRaH । azwAvete yatastasmAt kutapA iti viSrutAH” ॥ iti mitAkzarAyAmAcArADyAyaH ॥ sa ca triMSaddaRqadinamAne dvitIhapraharaSezadaRqAvaDi tftIyapraharapraTamadaRqaparyyantakAlaH । ityamaraH । 2 । 7 । 31 ॥ sa tu ekoddizwaSrAdDAramBakAlaH । yaTA, -- “AraBya kutape SrAdDaM kuryyAdArOhiRaM buDaH । viDijYo viDimAsTAya rOhiRantu na laNGayet” ॥ iti SrAdDatattvam ॥ “divasasyAzwame BAge mandImavati BAskaraH । sa kAlaH kutapo jYeyaH pitFRAmannamakzayam” ॥ iti SAtAtapaH ॥ * ॥ dOhitraH । vAdyam । CAgalomajakambalam । kuSatfRam । iti medinI ॥
puM, (kutsitaM pApaM tapati kuM BUmiM tapati vA । tapa + ac । kut + kapan vA .) sUryyaH । vESvAnaraH । dvijanmA । atiTiH । gOH । BAgineyaH । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: pu॰ kutsitaM pApaM tapati kuM BUmiM tapati--tapa--ac kutakapan vA । 1 sUryye 2 vahnO 3 atiTO 4 gavi 5 BAgineye 6 dvijAtO ca 7 dOhitre 8 vAdyaBede 9 nepAlakambale 10 kuSatfRe ca na॰ medi॰ । paYcadaSaDA viBaktadinasyAzwame 11 BAge amaraH ardDarcAdi “maDyAhnaH KaqgapAtraYca taTA nepAlakambalam । rOpya darBAstrilAH SAkaM dOhitraScAzwamaH smftaH” iti smftyuktezu azwasu padArTezu । “kutsitaM pApamityAhustrasya santApakAriRaH । azwAveteyastasmAt kutapA iti viSrutAH” iti smftyuktestezAM taTAtvam । ahnomuhUrttA viKyAtA daSa paYca ca sarvvadA । tatrAzwamo muhUrttoSaH sa kAlaH kutapaHsmftaH” smftiH । sa ca ekoddvizwaSrAdDAramBakAlaH “kutapapraTame BAge ekodizwamupakramet । AvarttanasamIpe vA tatrEva niyatAtmavAn” kAlamA॰ vyAsokteH । “AvarttanaM paScimadigavasTitacCAyAyAH pUrvvapadiggatikAlaH kutapaSezapadaRqa ityarTaH” raGu॰ । “AraBya kutape SrAdDaM kuryyAdArohiRaM buDaH । viDijYo viDimAsTAya rIhiRaM tu na laNGayet” gOtamaH । “divasasyAzwame BAge sandIBavati BAskaraH । sa kAlaH kutapojYeyaH pitFRAM dattamakzayam” mat॰ pu॰ “trIRi SrAdDe praSasyante dOhitraH kutapastilAH” manUktO dOhitratilAnAM pfTaNmirddeSAtuktakAlaparatA । taTAca tatrEva muKyatvam dOhitrAdO pariBAzikatvamiti vivekaH । jyotsnAdi॰ caturarTyAm aR । kOtapa tannirvfttAdO tri॰ ।
m: कु—तप mfn. slightly hot, W.
कु—तप m. n. (g. अर्धर्चादि) a sort of blanket (made of the hair of the mountain goat), Gaut.; Mn.; Yājñ.; VarBṛS.
कु—तप m. the Kuśa grass (Poa cynosuroides), Hcat.

the eighth Muhūrta or portion of the day from the last Daṇḍa of the second watch to the first of the third or about noon (an eligible time for the performance of sacrifices to the Manes), MBh. xiii, 6040; MatsyaP.
grain, L.
a daughter's son, L.
a sister's son, L.
a twice-born man (one of the first three classes), L.
a Brāhman, L.
a guest, L.
the sun, L.
fire, L.
an ox, L.
a kind of musical instrument, L.
कु-तप &c. See ib.
a: कुतपः — 1 A Brāhmaṇa. --2 A twiceborn man (द्विजन्मन्). --3 The sun. --4 Fire. --5 A guest. --6 An ox, a bull. --7 A daughter's son. --8 A sister's son. --9 Grain. --10 The eighth Muhūrta of the day; अह्नो मुहूर्ता विख्याता दश पंच च सर्वदा . तत्राष्टमो मुहूर्तो यः स कालः कुतपः स्मृतः .. --11 A musical instrument. --12 A time suitable for the performance of sacrifices to the manes. --पं The Kuśa grass

k.v: पितृदानं निवापः स्याच्छ्राद्धं तत्कर्म शास्त्रतः। अन्वाहार्यं मासिकेंऽशोऽष्टमोऽह्नः कुतपोऽस्त्रियाम्.।
भेद्यलिङ्गा अमी कूर्मी वीणाभेदश्च कच्छपी। रवर्णे पुंसि रेफः स्यात्कुत्सिते वाच्यलिङ्गकः॥ कुतपो मृगरोमोत्थपटे चाह्नोऽष्टमेंऽशके।

m: कु—तप-हार m. a partic. implement, (prob.) a sickle, Baudh.
कु—तप—सौश्रुत m. N. of a man g. पार्थिवादि.
कु—तप—सप्तक n. a Śrāddha in which seven constituents occur (viz. noon, a horn platter, a Nepāl blanket, silver, sacrificial grass, Sesamum, and kine), W.
कु—तपस्विन् m. a wicked or bad ascetic, Pañcat.
कु—तप-विन्यास m. arranging musical instruments and musicians, Bhar.
कु—तर्क m. fallacious argument, sophistry, BhP.; MārkP.
a bad logician, KapS. vi, 34
कु—तर्क—पथ m. ‘the way of sophists’, a sophistical method of arguing, Rājat. v, 378.

v: avya॰ kasmAt kim + tasil kimaH kuH । 1 kasmAdi tihetuvizaye 1 praSne 2 nihnave ca viSvaH । 3 Akzepavizaye hetO “madamUQavfdDizu vivekitA kutaH?” mAGaH “kutastvA kaSmalamidaM vizame samupasTitam” gItA । “kutastu Kalu BomyEvaM syAt kaTamasataH sajjAyeta” SrutiH । tataH Akze patiSayArTe tarap tamap vA Amu॰ ca॰ kutastarAm kutastamAm AkzepavizayahetvatiSaye avya॰ tatoBavArTe tyap । kutastya kutoBave tri॰ । “kutastyaM BIru! yatteByo druhyadByo'pi kzamAmahe” BawwiH ।
m: कुतस् ind. (fr. 1. कु), from whom? (for the abl. case of 2. क), RV. i, 164, 18; AV. viii, 9, 4
(कुतः कालात्, since what time? VP.)
from where? whence? RV. &c.
whereto? in which direction? BhP. viii, 19, 34
(आ कुतस्, up to where? Pat.)
where? R. vii, 23, 3
wherefore? why? from what cause or motive? because, Lāṭy. &c. (often in dramas before verses giving the reason of what precedes)
how? in what manner? ChUp. &c.

how much less? much less, ChUp.; MuṇḍUp.; MBh. &c. In अ-कुतस्, which occurs in comp., कुतस् has an indefinite sense (e.g. अ-कुतो-मृत्यु, not fearing death from any quarter, BhP. iii, 17, 19; cf. अ-कुतोभय)

कुतस् is also indefinite when connected with the particles अपि, चिद्, चन (e.g. कुतो ऽपि, from any quarter, from any cause, Pañcat.; कुतो ऽपि कारणात्, from any cause, Prab.; कुतश्-चिद्, from any one, from anywhere, RV.; KaṭhUp. &c. (cf. अकुतश्चिद्-भय); कुतश् चन, (with a negation preceding) from no side, RV.; TUp. &c.; to no side, R. v, 74, 21; यतः कुतश्-चिद् from any person soever Comm. on KātyŚr.)
a: कुतस् — ind. 1 From where, whence; कस्य त्वं वा कुत आयातः Moha M. 3. --2 Where, where else, in what (other) place &c.; ईदृग्विनोदः कुतः Ś. 2. 5. --3 Why, wherefore, from what cause or motive; कुत इदमुच्यते Ś. 5. --4 How, in what manner; स्फुरति च बाहुः कुतः फलमिहास्य Ś. 1. 15. --5 Much more, much less; न त्वत्समोस्त्यभ्यधिकः कुतोऽन्यः Bg. 11. 43, 4. 31; न मे स्तेनो जनपदे न कदर्यो… .न स्वैरी स्वैरिणी कुतः Ch. Up. --6 Because, for; Ś. 1. कुतस् is sometimes used merely for the abl. of किम्; कुतः कालात्समुत्पन्नं V. P. (= कस्मात् कालात् &c.). कुतः becomes indefinite when connected with the particles चिद्, चन, or अपि.

m: कुतस्त m. (for ˚तस्-त्य ?), N. of a man Comm. on TāṇḍyaBr. (cf. कौतस्त.)
कुतस्-तन mfn. coming from whence, i.e. not possible, Bhadrab.
कुतस्—तराम् ind. how? in what manner? KapS. i, 80.
कुतस्—त्य mfn. coming from where? Uttarar.; Prasannar.
(with अपि) of unknown origin, Uttarar.
a: कुतस्त्य — a. 1 Whence come; U. 3. 7. --2 How happened.

s: klI, (kutsitaM tfRamiva .) kumBI । iti hArA valI । pAnA iti BAzA ॥ (kumBikASabde 'sya vizwatirjYeyA ॥)
m: कु—तृण n. water houseleek (Pistia Stratiotes), L.
कु-तृण See 1. कु.
कु—तित्तिरि m. a species of bird resembling the partridge, Suśr.
कुतो (in comp. for कुतस्).
कुतो—मूल mfn. having what origin? MBh. i, 6205; Car.

v: tri॰ kutaH kiM nimittaM yasya kim + praTamArTe tasil ba॰ va॰ । kinnimitte kiMhetuke । “kutonimittaH Sokaste” rAmA॰ ।
m: कुतो—निमित्त mfn. having what cause or reason? R. ii, 74, 17.

s: vya, (“saptamyAstral” । 5 । 3 । 10 । iti tral .) kasmin iti vyAkaraRam । koTAya iti BAzA ॥ (yaTA, mAhAnAwake । “hA ! sItA kena nItA mama hfdayagatA kena vA kutra dfzwA” ॥)
v: avya॰ kim + saptamyAH tral--kimaH kuH । kasminnityarTe praSnavizaye Akzepavizaye ca aDikaraRe “hA sItA kena nItA mama hfdayagatA kena vA kutra dfzwo” mahAnAwa॰ “kutrASizaH SrutisuKA mfgatfzRirUpAH” BAga॰ 7 । 9 । 25 । tato BavArTetyap । kutratya kasminBave tri॰ “kasyApi kutratya ihApi kasmAt” BAga॰ 5 । 10 । 20 ।
m: कुत्र ind. (fr. 1. कु), where? whereto? in which case? when? RV. &c.
wherefore? Pañcat.; Hit.

कुत्र-क्व, where (this) -where (that) i.e. how distant or how different is this from that, how little is this consistent with that? BhP. vii, 9, 25. कुत्र becomes indefinite when connected with the particles अपि, चिद्, e.g. कुत्रापि, anywhere, somewhere, wherever, to any place, wheresoever, Pañcat.; MārkP.
कुत्रा चिद् [RV.] or कुत्र चिद् [R. &c.], anywhere, somewhere, wheresoever
न कुत्र चिद्, nowhere, to no place whatsoever, MBh.; Pañcat.
= कस्मिंश्-चिद्, e.g. कुत्र चिद् अरण्ये, in a certain wood, Pañcat.
कुत्र चिद्-कुत्र चिद्, in one case-in the other case, sometimes-sometimes, Mn. ix, 34
यत्र कुत्र चिद्, wherever it be, here or there Comm. on KapS. i, 69.
a: कुत्र — ind. 1 Where, in which place; कुत्र मे शिशुः Pt. 1; प्रवृत्तिः कुत्र कर्तव्या H. 1. --2 In which case; तेजसा सह जातानां वयः कुत्रोपयुज्यते Pt. 1. 328. (कुत्र is sometimes used for the loc. sing. of किम्). When connected with the particles चिद्, चन or अपि, कुत्र becomes indefinite in sense. कुत्रापि, --कुत्रचित् somewhere, anywhere; न कुत्रापि no where; कुत्रचित्-कुत्रचित् in one place-in another place, herehere; Ms. 9. 34.

s: vya, (kutra ca cit ca iti dvandvasamAsaH । mugDaboDamate “kimaH ktyantAcciccanO” । iticit .) konaKAne iti BAzA । iti vyAkaraRam । (yaTA mahABArate । 3 । 142 । 53 । “asureByo BayaM nAsti yuzmAkaM kutracit kvacit” ॥)
v: avya॰ kutra + cit mugDa॰ । kvacidityarTe asAkalyena kasmit deSe kAle vetyarTe । “asureByoBayaM nAsti yuzmAkaM kutracit kvacit” BA॰ va॰ 142 a॰ । kutracit deSe kvacit kAle ityarTaH । pA॰ amaramate padadvayamiti BedaH । “viSizwaM kutracidvIjaM strIyonistveva tu kutracit” manuH । cana । kutracana tatrArTe avya॰ ।

m: कुत्र—त्य mfn. where living or residing? BhP.; Daś.
a: कुत्रत्य — a. Where living or residing.

m: कुत्स् (perhaps related to कुतस्) cl. 10. P. कुत्सयति [also Ā. ˚यते, Dhātup.; rarely cl. 1. P. कुत्सति, MBh. ii, 2298 and 2303; once cl. 4. P. कुत्स्यति, R. vii, 43, 18], to despise, abuse, revile, contemn, Mn.; Yājñ.; &c.;

m: कुत्स m. N. of a Ṛṣi (called Ārjuneya, author of several hymns of the RV.; when attacked by the demon Śuṣṇa, Indra defended him and killed the demon; but in other hymns [RV. i, 53, 10; ii, 14, 7; iv, 26, 1; viii, 53, 2] Kutsa is represented as persecuted by Indra), RV.; AV. iv, 29, 5; TāṇḍyaBr.
N. of a descendant of Aṅgiras (author of the hymns, RV. i, 94-98; 100-115; ix, 97, 45 seqq.), ĀśvŚr.
lightning, thunderbolt, Naigh.; Nir.
(also) a distance of about 30 inches, L.
कुत्स (आस्), m. pl. (Pāṇ. ii, 4, 65) the descendants or the family of Kutsa, RV. vii, 25, 5; Lāṭy.
कुत्स (अम्), n. the plant Costus speciosus or arabicus, L.; (cf. कौत्स, पुरु-कुत्स, &c.)
